Equipment:Seal, Forced Air 
 Fan, Gas Circulation Fan
 SL FAN, FD Fan, GR Fan

This document out lines the details 
equipment inspection I1, performed on a month bases and every six months as 
indicated by M1:M6 in the above title block.

The function of Seal Fan to supply the boiler with SEAL air, the 
forced air fan to supply the boiler with combustion air, and the GR fan to 
circulate the hot gas to increase the boiler efficiency

The first 
draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla. reviewed by directed by eng: Gamal 
Arafa and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd 
El-Salam, approved by eng: Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power 
Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al-lethy Head sector of EDEPCo. Inspection 
& 
quality control.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 SL FAN

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this SL FAN

The SL FAN must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing suction and delivery valve.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device. Feeler gauge

Hammer,
 Dial indicator, Torque wrench

Disconnect the fan side half coupling from the rotor and 
 inspect both the fan side and the motor side half couplings for wear.

Clean all parts and re-grease jacking fixtures are required to 
 remove the coupling hubs.

In addition to these Fixtures, the hydraulic jacks are 
 required. Torque requirements for bolts.

Check the alignment of the motor, intermediate shaft (if 
 applicable), and the couplings. "Wear of damage may affect the Fan balance".
Check all lube oil and hydraulic system hoses, piping, and fittings for leaks.
Check rotor & blade liners.
Check and repair as required housing & inlet box.
Check and adjust as required coupling wear & alignment.
Check and adjust as required damper blades & linkages.
Check and adjust as required rotor body bound bolts.
Check and adjust as required shaft bearings & seals.

Check the
 Inlet cone clearances.

Check the bearing oil level and 
 adjust as required

Check the main bearing temperature. refer to start - stop sequence for alarm 
 and trip temp
Check the bearing cooling water flow
Check the lube oil lins for oil line leakage
Check the fan for smooth operation

Check all anchor bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if 
 necessary
Check the bearing oil for contamination
Check the fan blades for wear

Examine rotor & blade liners for any signs of erosion, and remove all traces 
 of deposit before carrying out this examination. Should there be evidence of 
 severe abrasion, If there is not any severe abrasion, and the rotor is to be 
 used again without repairs, check for fan balance.
Examine fan housing and inlet box for signs of wear.
Body bound bolts of rotor inner plate/shaft connection for wear
Examine damper assemblies for wear of blades and blade spindles

Examine bearings & couplings, and make adjustments or replacements if 
 necessary. Give particular attention to bearing seals

Check position of rotor in fan housing relative to the inlet cone, make 
 adjustments if necessary, check shaft seals at inlet box
Check shaft seals at inlet box

Tighten all hold down bolts in fan housing, sole plates, bearings, and base 
 frames.
Check coupling alignment
